subject: 元北方山庄大院（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: background-extraction and precise-object-edit. Preserve this Yuan northern Chinese manor building and all geometry, gray roofs, buff walls, two courts and single tree. Remove EVERY pixel of blurred colorful glow/backdrop OUTSIDE the building/apron. Output true RGBA transparency around isolated complete building, fully transparent empty background; NO gradient, NO halo, NO colored matte, NO shadow outside thin ground footprint. Retain opaque building surfaces. Additionally simplify the upward-curling finials to plain ridges and remove extra low bushes. Camera remains orthographic 2:1 dimetric, ground axes +/-0.5. Leave10% empty transparent margins on every side. Do not add objects, text or scenery.
negative: 文字、伪字、人物、现代物、天空、地平线、棋盘格、背景建筑、大阴影、厚地台、清式宫廷装饰、透视消失点、裁切。

references.role: 宋基线材质参考，第一候选输入
第一候选；第二候选输入

historical_references.title: 品读 | 永乐宫的建筑——杜仙洲
historical_references.used: 元代木构、单檐庑殿/歇山、平缓屋面、土坯墙和砖裙的形制母题；文中明确部分梁架清修，不能整体倒推元貌。

created_time_basis: 生成后归档时间，非工具披露服务端时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; round dimensions to pixels
paste without mask into transparent canvas; no warp/repaint/flip/alpha threshold

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面左/前/右角，±3px；锚取左右角中点；非图片中心，非3D测绘。

notes: 双院、土墙、灰瓦为游戏概化；第二候选清理屋脊和院内杂灌。原始预览可见背景RGB色晕，采样外围alpha=0，最终采用真实RGBA；透明区隐藏RGB未人为修改。部分底面角度仍需返修。
footprint_basis: 【建议值】元北方同功能模块占地；非上游冻结数值、非历史测绘。

visual_qa.note: 逐张目视轮廓/材质/光向；不替代严格几何、历史复原及作者审批。
